a singular achievement: Winning three gold medals at her first Olympics was a singular achievement for such a young swimmer.
在她第一次參加奧運就贏得三面金牌，對這麼年輕的泳將來說是非凡的成就。
the singular form: In English class we learned that the singular form of "mice" is "mouse," not "mouses."
在英文課上我們學到 mice 的單數形是 mouse，而不是 mouses。
a singular lack of: At yesterday's meeting, the manager showed a singular lack of respect when he laughed at our ideas.
在昨天的會議上，經理嘲笑我們的想法，表現出極度缺乏尊重。
in the singular: Some nouns, such as "news," look plural, but we always use them with a verb in the singular.
有些名詞，例如 news，看起來是複數，但我們總是搭配以單數形式出現的動詞。
be skillful at: My sister has always been skillful at drawing, so her pictures often win prizes in school contests.
我姊姊一直很擅長畫畫，所以她的作品常在學校比賽中得獎。
a skillful negotiator: As a skillful negotiator, my uncle managed to get the car for two thousand dollars less than the price.
身為一位手腕高明的談判者，我叔叔成功以比售價低兩千美元的價格買到那輛車。
skillful handling: Thanks to the pilot's skillful handling of the plane during the storm, all the passengers landed safely.
多虧機師在暴風雨中巧妙的處理飛機，所有乘客都安全降落。
skinny jeans: These skinny jeans are so tight around my legs that I can hardly sit down in them.
這件緊身牛仔褲把我的腿包得好緊，我穿著幾乎坐不下來。
a skinny latte: Trying to eat healthier, Amy now orders a skinny latte made with low-fat milk every morning.
為了吃得更健康，艾咪現在每天早上都點一杯用低脂牛奶做的低脂拿鐵。
the skinny on: You were at the meeting, so give me the skinny on what the boss said about our bonuses.
你有去開會，所以告訴我老闆對我們獎金說了什麼的內幕吧。
a slender chance: The team is ten points behind with one minute left, so they have only a slender chance of winning.
這支隊伍在剩一分鐘時落後十分，所以他們只有微小的機會獲勝。
a slender majority: The new law passed by a slender majority, with only two more votes for it than against it.
這項新法律以微弱多數通過，贊成票只比反對票多兩票。
slender resources: With slender resources and only three workers, the small charity still helps hundreds of families each year.
這個小慈善團體只有有限的資源和三名工作人員，每年仍幫助數百個家庭。
a slender figure: The dancer has a slender figure because she practices ballet for several hours every day.
這位舞者有著修長的身材，因為她每天練習芭蕾好幾個小時。
a slender margin: She won the race by a slender margin, crossing the finish line just half a second before the others.
她以微小的差距贏得比賽，只比其他人早半秒衝過終點線。
a slight chance: The weather report says there is a slight chance of rain, so you might want to bring an umbrella.
氣象報告說有微小的下雨機會，所以你或許該帶把傘。
a slight improvement: His grades showed a slight improvement this term, but he still needs to work harder in math.
他這學期的成績略微改善，但數學還需要更加努力。
not in the slightest: When I asked if the long hike had made her tired, she smiled and said, "Not in the slightest."
當我問她長途健行是否讓她很累時，她笑著說：「一點也不。」
a slight exaggeration: Saying that the whole school came to the concert is a slight exaggeration; about half of the students came.
說全校都來看音樂會是略微誇大了；大約一半的學生來了。
a slight cold: I only have a slight cold with a runny nose, so I still went to school today.
我只是輕微感冒、流點鼻水，所以今天還是去上學了。
at the slightest provocation: Our neighbor's dog barks loudly at the slightest provocation, even when a leaf falls in the yard.
我們鄰居的狗一有刺激就大聲吠叫，連院子裡掉一片葉子都會叫。
a slippery slope: Copying a friend's homework once may seem harmless, but it can be a slippery slope toward cheating on exams.
抄一次朋友的作業看似無害，但這可能是走向考試作弊、每況愈下的開端。
a slippery customer: Be careful when you buy a car from him; he is a slippery customer who often breaks his promises.
跟他買車時要小心；他是個狡猾不可靠的人，常常不守承諾。
slippery roads: After the heavy rain, drivers were warned to slow down on the slippery roads in the mountains.
大雨過後，駕駛人被提醒在山區滑溜的路面上要減速。
a slippery concept: Happiness is a slippery concept, because every person seems to define it in a different way.
幸福是個難以界定的概念，因為每個人似乎都用不同的方式來定義它。
a sober assessment: Before deciding to open the shop, the owners made a sober assessment of the costs and risks involved.
在決定開店之前，店主們對相關的成本和風險做了清醒冷靜的評估。
sober colors: Guests at the funeral were asked to wear sober colors, like black and dark gray, to show respect.
參加喪禮的賓客被要求穿素淨的顏色，像是黑色和深灰色，以表示尊重。
stone-cold sober: Although everyone else at the party was drinking, Tom stayed stone-cold sober because he had to drive home.
雖然派對上其他人都在喝酒，湯姆卻保持完全清醒，因為他得開車回家。
a sober reminder: The terrible car accident was a sober reminder that we should always wear our seat belts.
那場可怕的車禍是一個嚴肅的提醒：我們應該隨時繫好安全帶。
sober up: After drinking too much at the wedding, he drank several cups of black coffee to sober up.
在婚禮上喝太多之後，他喝了好幾杯黑咖啡來醒酒。
in a sober mood: After hearing the sad news about their teacher, the students left the classroom in a sober mood.
聽到關於老師的壞消息後，學生們帶著嚴肅的心情離開教室。
